{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the presence of the six QA orders with 999999.99 revenue
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders with revenue 999999.99: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if any other rows have revenue that looks like a sentinel
sentinel_revenue = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'QA orders detected: {len(sentinel_revenue)}')

# Also check for any non-numeric revenue values
non_numeric_revenue = data[~data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').str.replace('.', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric()]
print(f'Rows with non-numeric revenue: {len(non_numeric_revenue)}')"}
